nodes.name: 2a. Postgres Bronze: Save Raw Firecrawl Markdown & HTML (ML Lake)

assignments.name: output.mining_oil_change_pts
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = ($json.data?.markdown || $json.markdown || '').match(/\|\s*Mining and Oil\s*\|\s*[\d,.]+\s*\|\s*([\d,.]+)\s*\|\s*([\d,.]+)(▲|▼)?/); return m ? Number(m[1].replace(/,/g, '')) * (m[3] === '▼' ? -1 : 1) : 0; })() }}

assignments.name: output.mining_oil_pct
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = ($json.data?.markdown || $json.markdown || '').match(/\|\s*Mining and Oil\s*\|\s*[\d,.]+\s*\|\s*([\d,.]+)\s*\|\s*([\d,.]+)(▲|▼)?/); return m ? Number(m[2].replace(/,/g, '')) * (m[3] === '▼' ? -1 : 1) : 0; })() }}

assignments.name: output.sectors_summary
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const md = $json.data?.markdown || $json.markdown || ''; const parseRow = (label, display) => { const m = md.match(new RegExp('\\|\\s*' + label + '\\s*\\|\\s*([\\d,.]+)\\s*\\|\\s*([\\d,.]+)\\s*\\|\\s*([\\d,.]+)(▲|▼)?')); const arrow = m?.[4] || '▲'; const sign = arrow === '▼' ? -1 : 1; return { sector: display, arrow, up_down: arrow === '▼' ? 'DOWN' : 'UP', value: m ? Number(m[1].replace(/,/g, '')) : 0, change_pts: m ? Number(m[2].replace(/,/g, '')) * sign : 0, change_pct: m ? Number(m[3].replace(/,/g, '')) * sign : 0 }; }; return [ parseRow('All Shares', 'All Shares'), parseRow('Financials', 'Financial'), parseRow('Industrial', 'Industrial'), parseRow('Holding Firms', 'Holding Firms'), parseRow('Property', 'Property'), parseRow('Services', 'Services'), parseRow('Mining and Oil', 'Mining & Oil') ]; })() }}

assignments.name: canva_autofill_data
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = $('7. ETL Merge All Transformed Streams').item.json; const o = m.output || {}; const t = (v) => ({ type: 'text', text: String(v ?? '') }); const d = { as_of: t(o.as_of), psei_value: t(o.psei_close), psei_up_down: t(o.psei_up_down), psei_arrow: t(o.psei_arrow), psei_change_pts: t(o.psei_change_pts), psei_change_pct: t((o.psei_change_pct ?? 0) + '%'), value_turnover: t('₱' + Number(o.total_value_turnover || 0).toLocaleString()), advancers: t(o.advancers), decliners: t(o.decliners), unchanged: t(o.unchanged), explanation: t($json.data['Canva Graphic Caption'] || ''), all_shares_arrow: t(o.all_shares_arrow), all_shares_value: t(o.all_shares_close), all_shares_chg_pct: t((o.all_shares_pct ?? 0) + '%'), all_shares_chg_pts: t(o.all_shares_change_pts), financial_arrow: t(o.financials_arrow), financial_value: t(o.financials_close), financial_chg_pct: t((o.financials_pct ?? 0) + '%'), financial_chg_pts: t(o.financials_change_pts), industrial_arrow: t(o.industrial_arrow), industrial_value: t(o.industrial_close), industrial_chg_pct: t((o.industrial_pct ?? 0) + '%'), industrial_chg_pts: t(o.industrial_change_pts), holding_firms_arrow: t(o.holding_firms_arrow), holding_firms_value: t(o.holding_firms_close), holding_firms_chg_pct: t((o.holding_firms_pct ?? 0) + '%'), holding_firms_chg_pts: t(o.holding_firms_change_pts), property_arrow: t(o.property_arrow), property_value: t(o.property_close), property_chg_pct: t((o.property_pct ?? 0) + '%'), property_chg_pts: t(o.property_change_pts), services_arrow: t(o.services_arrow), services_value: t(o.services_close), services_chg_pct: t((o.services_pct ?? 0) + '%'), services_chg_pts: t(o.services_change_pts), mining_oil_arrow: t(o.mining_oil_arrow), mining_oil_value: t(o.mining_oil_close), mining_oil_chg_pct: t((o.mining_oil_pct ?? 0) + '%'), mining_oil_chg_pts: t(o.mining_oil_change_pts) }; (m.most_active || []).slice(0, 3).forEach((s, idx) => { const n = idx + 1; d['most_active_' + n + '_rank'] = t(n); d['most_active_' + n + '_symbol'] = t(s.symbol); d['most_active_' + n + '_name'] = t(s.name); d['most_active_' + n + '_price'] = t(s.price_formatted); d['most_active_' + n + '_chg_pct'] = t(s.percent_change_formatted); d['most_active_' + n + '_value_traded'] = t(s.value_traded_formatted); d['most_active_' + n + '_trades'] = t(s.trades_formatted); }); (m.dividend_yield_stocks || []).forEach((s) => { d['div_' + s.symbol + '_price'] = t(s.price_formatted); d['div_' + s.symbol + '_chg_pct'] = t(s.percent_change_formatted); d['div_' + s.symbol + '_dps'] = t('₱' + Number(s.div_per_share_ttm || 0).toFixed(2)); d['div_' + s.symbol + '_yield'] = t(Number(s.dividend_yield_ttm || 0).toFixed(2) + '%'); d['div_' + s.symbol + '_min_inv'] = t('₱' + Number(s.min_investment || 0).toLocaleString()); }); (m.reit_stocks || []).forEach((s) => { d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_price'] = t(s.price_formatted); d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_chg_pct'] = t(s.percent_change_formatted); d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_turnover'] = t(s.value_traded_formatted); d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_yield'] = t(Number(s.dividend_yield_ttm || 0).toFixed(2) + '%'); d['reit_' + s.symbol + '_min_inv'] = t('₱' + Number(s.min_investment || 0).toLocaleString()); }); return d; })() }}
